_comment: GATE B (decisive, basis-isolated): spot-64 + 4 basis-SEQ channels (X=68, data/npz_dualbasis ch64..67 = basis_bps/z/mom/ema_dev over the 600-step window) -> LEAK-FREE PERP y_600. use_perp_residual=FALSE so this ISOLATES the basis-channel effect (no perp deep-book confound). IDENTICAL trainer/config to perp_baseline_choppy.json (the Step-2 spot64 baseline) EXCEPT npz_dir=data/npz_dualbasis (68ch vs 64ch). n_features (68) read from data. Choppy fold-0 (test 2026-01), train 400d / val 60d / embargo 1, EMA 0.999, preload=false (memory-safe; the prior preload=true dualbasis roll OOM'd rc=137). THE QUESTION: does basis lift perp from the ~0.008 spot baseline toward 0.024? Ridge showed basis predicts the residual r at 0.57 IC, but JOINT mixing into one regression HURT perp_y (-0.0013); only ADDITIVE spot_yhat+basis_rhat helped. This DL config is the joint-mixing caliber, so expect <= baseline unless the conformer learns the additive structure the linear Ridge could not. Run via train_dual_lob.py --start-fold 0 --max-folds 1.
